must_fix.description: JSON output format does not match the Issue spec - missing 'changed_files', 'impact', 'overlap', and 'summary' fields
must_fix.reason: The Issue specifies the JSON output should have: changed_files, impact (with file+related), overlap, summary (with changed/total_impacted/overlap_count). The implementation instead outputs: input_files, impacted_files (with file_path/score/relation_types/impacted_by), total_input_files, total_impacted_files. Key differences: (1) No 'overlap' array. (2) No 'summary' object with changed/total_impacted/overlap_count. (3) Field naming differs. (4) The 'impact' array in the spec uses 'related' sub-arrays per file, but the implementation flattens/aggregates into a single list.

should_fix.reason: The Issue requires 'overlap（共通影響ファイル）が検出される'. The aggregate_impact function tracks impacted_by but does not produce an explicit overlap list.
The Issue spec explicitly shows a summary object with changed/total_impacted/overlap_count keys.

should_fix.description: E2E test for 'impact_excludes_input_files_from_results' checks wrong JSON field name
should_fix.reason: The test filters on f["path"] but the JSON output uses f["file_path"]. This means the test assertion is vacuously true.

nice_to_have.description: No E2E test verifying overlap detection
nice_to_have.reason: Once overlap is implemented, a test should verify that when two input files share a common impacted file, it appears in the overlap array.

nice_to_have.description: No E2E test for empty stdin (terminal detection)
nice_to_have.reason: No test verifying the error message when stdin is a terminal and no file arguments are provided.

nice_to_have.description: Human output does not show overlap information
nice_to_have.reason: If overlap detection is added, the human output should also highlight overlapping files.

nice_to_have.description: CLI help could mention git diff pipe pattern for discoverability
nice_to_have.reason: The Issue title mentions 'git diff ベース' but the CLI help does not mention this usage pattern.

summary: Core impact functionality is well-implemented but JSON output structure does not match the Issue spec. Missing overlap array and summary object. E2E test has a field name bug.
